headline: I've owned an agent platform end to end, from the agents to the servers they run on.
pitch: I created loom (now Noewright), the agent engine CoNexus runs six specialized agents on in production; at DGRS Labs I also built an in-house model service on open-source models that cut operating costs by 30%, and run the company's entire infrastructure, including incident response and disaster recovery. I write Python, Go, Rust and TypeScript.

matches.requirement: Strong Python; TypeScript, Go or Rust a plus
matches.evidence: Python: open-source AI agents for Degenerous AI and Equity's Django REST Framework APIs. Go: buckt and loom's engine. Rust: USSD framework components at Equity.

matches.requirement: Production experience with LLM applications and agents
matches.evidence: Created loom (now Noewright), my own agent engine, which coordinates six agents in production for CoNexus with plugins to external tools and a no-code admin. Stored story embeddings with pgvector so the AI retrieves the context it needs.

matches.requirement: Owning critical systems, including incident response
matches.evidence: Sole owner of DevOps at DGRS Labs since 2024. I built a dashboard that sends errors to Telegram and a disaster-recovery system that restores the full stack automatically.

matches.requirement: Cloud platforms, Kubernetes and managed data stores
matches.evidence: Deployed Equity's services via Azure Pipelines and Kubernetes with Redis; at DGRS Labs I run PostgreSQL and tuned it to cut reads by 40%.

matches.requirement: Building production systems end to end, ideally early-stage
matches.evidence: Lead a team of three across DGRS Labs' AI product suite, owning architecture through delivery, with CI/CD and environments I set up.

resume.summary: Lead software engineer with 5+ years building and running production systems in AI and fintech. Created loom (now Noewright), an agent orchestration engine that runs six specialized agents in production, built an in-house model service on open-source models, and single-handedly runs the company's infrastructure, incident response and disaster recovery. Writes Python, Go, Rust and TypeScript. Previously led delivery of a USSD loan service on a financial platform serving 16 million customers.

note:
A founding engineer for agent-native systems needs to own the agents and the systems under them at once. That has been my job at DGRS Labs: I built the agent platform, the model service and the infrastructure, and I'm the one who responds when something breaks.

What I'd bring first is that end-to-end ownership, and a working sense of where agents fail in production and how to recover cleanly.

What would be new: forecasting and time-series models, which I haven't built. Your post on X listed remote while the job page lists Beijing and Shanghai; I'm in Lagos (UTC+1) and would like to know whether remote from here works, or whether relocation is an option.
